content.text: This is a supplier's technical spec sheet for a furniture or home product. It may mix Portuguese, Italian, German and English, and may span several pages (for example a separate price list). Extract the fields exactly as written: keep the original units (do not convert), keep decimal commas, and put the exact text you read in source_text. Use null for empty fields or dashes. variants: one entry per row of the variants or price table. safety_warnings: every warning sentence as written, one entry per language version. claims: only statements about health, safety or the environment (e.g. antibacterial, fireproof, eco-friendly), not design or comfort.
